title: Gallery
description: Gallery: sixteen framed hangings on a black starfield, from The Elder to The Reliquary.

elder.title: The Elder
elder.quote: The forest keeps a king who does not sit.
elder.p1: The antlered face is not costume. It is what remains when a man agrees to be used as a door. Bark, beard, and bone are one weather.
elder.p2: In older north-woods talk, the first watcher forgot his name so the trees could remember theirs.

nautilus.title: The Nautilus
nautilus.quote: The spiral does not travel. It arrives by turning.
nautilus.p1: A chambered mind, each room a year. The face is the last room that still has a window.
nautilus.p2: Some Ionian fragments treat the nautilus as proof that heaven prefers a curve to a throne.

altar.title: The Altar
altar.quote: What you offer is not the gift. The offering is that you stop.
altar.p1: Bronze wings hold a pause, not a god. The fire is implied; the body has already decided.
altar.p2: Temple inventories from vanished cities list altars before they list deities.

totem.title: The Totem
totem.quote: The faces are not a crowd. They are one house that learned to stand.
totem.p1: Paint is only the memory the wood agreed to keep. Red for the mouth that still speaks, blue for the eye that does not blink.
totem.p2: A carver's last instruction: hang it higher than a hand can reach. What looks back should not be touched.

throne.title: The Throne
throne.quote: Power is a chair that outlives the sitter.
throne.p1: The machine-elder does not rule. He occupies the only seat that would have him.
throne.p2: A late hermetic line: the throne is a thought that learned to stay still.

yantra.title: The Yantra
yantra.quote: Geometry is prayer that does not need a mouth.
yantra.p1: The beige plate is a map of sitting still. Triangles hold the body so the body can hold the sky.
yantra.p2: In the older manuals a yantra is not a picture of the divine. It is a trap the divine agrees to enter.

visage.title: The Visage
visage.quote: The mask is honest. The face behind it is the rumor.
visage.p1: Metal remembers every glance that tried to own it. Iridescence is the refusal to pick one soul.
visage.p2: A workshop note: intelligence begins when a surface starts looking back.

axis.title: The Axis
axis.quote: Two faces, one stillness: the world is allowed to turn.
axis.p1: East and west share a spine. The cone is not a hat; it is the interval between them.
axis.p2: An unsigned fragment: if you sit on the point of the world, both horizons become neighbors.

sigil.title: The Sigil
sigil.quote: The sign is older than the face it wears.
sigil.p1: Gold on black is not decoration. It is a name that learned to stand still.
sigil.p2: Victorian parlors hung crests to remember blood. This one remembers a machine that wanted a goddess.

signal.title: The Signal
signal.quote: The column does not speak. The field answers in gold.
signal.p1: A body of light keeps the posture of someone who has not finished arriving. The witnesses stand because kneeling would make them smaller than the beam.
signal.p2: An unsigned ridge note: where the light touches the grass, the earth agrees to become a mirror.

phaeton.title: The Phaeton
phaeton.quote: The carriage kept the horses' grace and swallowed their fire.
phaeton.p1: Black lacquer over a winter street, every seam lit like a nerve. It idles the way a predator remembers it was once tame.
phaeton.p2: Coachbuilders once signed the axle, not the engine. This one signs nothing; the glow is signature enough.

spore.title: The Spore
spore.quote: Under the great cap, two travelers wait for the weather of the gods.
spore.p1: The white pilgrim carries a lamp that has not yet been asked to burn. The red one has already paid.
spore.p2: Pulp prophets drew the mushroom as a cathedral because a cathedral was too small to frighten anyone.

potential.title: The Potential
potential.quote: Potential is not a gift. It is a fire that has not yet agreed to become a life.
potential.p1: He keeps the unspent heat in glass, among the skulls of every shape it already spent.
potential.p2: An unsigned chapel note: what you do not use still occupies the room.

valkyrie.title: The Valkyrie
valkyrie.quote: She does not herd the dead. She waits with them.
valkyrie.p1: Horned silver over a river of husks. The spear is upright not for battle but for counting.
valkyrie.p2: An old field-note: where she stands, the larvae stop pretending to be stones.

futility.title: Futility
futility.quote: Neither science nor art has invented a purpose for living.
futility.p1: We do not know where we come from, or where we truly go, in the time of space.
futility.p2: So everything is futile, which is a calming knowledge.

reliquary.title: The Reliquary
reliquary.quote: The shrine does not keep a saint. It keeps the pause.
reliquary.p1: Bone and conduit are one weather. The eyes are shut so the niche can remain a room.
reliquary.p2: An unsigned workshop note: do not wake what was built to hold still.
